summary: Petition under Sections 17(3) and 17(4) of the Electricity Act, 2003 for the creation of security interest over the Petitioner’s Assets in favour of Respondent No.15 as the Debenture Trustee acting for the benefit of the Debenture Holders. 2. The Petitioner has filed the present Petition for approval for the creation and perfection of a Security Interest in terms of the Debenture Trust Deed through the mortgage, hypothecation, charge, or assignment over rights, title, interest, claims, demands, benefits under, clearance, project documents, agreements, and approvals (with the exception of security over the fixed assets) of the Petitioner in favour of the Catalyst Trusteeship Limited (Respondent No. 15). Additionally, the Petitioner has requested for the approval of documents that create security as well as other documents pertaining to the debenture facility. The Petitioner has made the following _(b) approve the creation of Security Interest by way of hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ assignment etc., over all the assets including the movable and immovable assets, Project accounts, Project documents (including the transmission license) etc. of the Petitioner in favour of Respondent No. 15/ Debenture Trustee (or its replacement or successor) to secure the Petitioner’s obligations towards the Debenture Trustee under the Debenture Trust Deed dated 13.12.2024 (read with the Debenture Documents);_ _(c) approve the creation of Security Interest by way of hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ assignment etc., over all the assets including the movable and immovable assets, Project accounts, Project documents (including the transmission license) etc. of the Petitioner in favour of Respondent No. 15/ Debenture Trustee (or its replacement or successor) to secure the Petitioner’s obligations towards the Debenture Trustee under the Debenture Trust Deed dated 13.12.2024 (read with the Debenture Documents) and for their subsequent transferees, assigns, novatees and substitutes thereof in respect to the Project; and_ _(d) pass any such other relief as the Commission deems fit and appropriate in the facts and circumstances of the case."_ 7. As per the Debenture Trust Deed, the Petitioner has agreed to provide the following security to secure the Debenture-II: 8. The Petitioner has submitted that, in terms of Article 15.2 of the Transmission Service Agreement, it is entitled to create an encumbrance over all or part of its receivables or transmission assets in favour of the Debenture Trustee, subject to obtaining prior approval from this Commission. 9. The Petitioner has further submitted that in view of the provisions of subsections (3) and (4) of Section 17 of the Act, the Petitioner, as a licensee, cannot create a Security in favour of and/or for the benefit of the Debenture Holder pursuant to an amended without the approval of this Commission. Accordingly, the Petitioner has filed the present Petition seeking approval of the Commission for the creation of security by the Petitioner over the Petitioner’s Assets in favour of Respondent No. 15 acting as the Debenture Trustee for the benefit of the Debenture Holders and for their subsequent transferees, assignees, novatees thereof by way of hypothecation/ assignment/ mortgage, to the extent described in this Petition to secure the Petitioner’s obligations towards the Debenture Trustee under the Debenture Trust Deed dated 13.12.2024 aggregating to Rs. 2450,00,00,000/- only. 10. The matter was admitted on 8.4.2025, and notices were issued to the parties to file their respective replies. However, no reply has been filed by the Respondents. 11. Vide Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as “RoP”) for the hearing on 8.4.2025, the Petitioner was directed to submit, within two weeks, an affidavit containing a statement detailing the sources and application of funds as on the date of the Petition, along with a statement of the total project cost. 13. During the course of the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner primarily reiterated the submissions made in the Petition. The learned counsel for Respondent No. 2, GUVNL, submitted that the creation of a security interest by the Petitioner ought not to prejudice or affect the rights of GUVNL under the Transmission Service Agreement. Considering the submissions made by the parties, the matter was reserved for orders. 14. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner and perused the documents available on record. The Petitioner had earlier availed financial assistance in the form of a term loan facility from the Power Finance Corporation Limited (Respondent No. 16) for an aggregate sanctioned amount of Rs. 2,069.58 crores towards part-financing the construction and development of the Project. In connection with the said facility, the Petitioner entered into a Facility Agreement dated 19.10.2021, read with the amendment dated 27.3.2021. Pursuant to the said arrangement, the Petitioner approached this Commission seeking approval for the creation of a security interest over its assets in favour of Respondent No. 16. The Commission, vide order 16. The Petitioner has further submitted that, in terms of sub-sections (3) and (4) of Section 17 of the Act, 2003, as a transmission licensee, it cannot create any security interest over its assets in favour of the Debenture Trustee without the prior approval of this Commission. Accordingly, the present Petition has been filed seeking approval for creation of security over the Petitioner’s assets, in favour of Respondent No. 15, acting as Debenture Trustee for the benefit of the Debenture Holders and their respective transferees, assignees, and novatees, by way of hypothecation, assignment, or mortgage, as detailed in the Petition, to secure the Petitioner’s obligations under the Debenture Trust Deed dated 13.12.2024, for the loan facility aggregating Rs. 2,450 crores .
